findings.reason: as written the node's central measure passes on the unmodified tree, so §10 would be closed on a test that never exercised its change; it must assert what the move actually buys (the station dispatches and no subscriber's sweep reads the fleet, per §3's read budget) or trace the sweep count, not the review count.
findings.text: the negative control "running the reflex per subscriber must fail the exactly-one test" cannot fire: `dispatch_review_for_run` returns `dispatched: false` with "a review is already in flight as a live run" whenever `_review_in_flight` finds the pair (run, head) already standing (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:491-520, guard at :2127-2158), so three subscribers sweeping the same session in sequence produce exactly one review on today's code and the exactly-one test passes unfixed

findings.reason: the same plan error sends a node to edit the writer and add a second consumer-visible meaning to a slot three other rules read, instead of a one-line change to the reader using a function already written and already used by the sibling withdrawal rule; the collision it risks is a run whose legitimate lift never fires.
findings.text: §10 prescribes "This section makes the advice door write the same stamp the reader takes", but the advice door needs no new write: every resume launch goes through `_resume` and calls `_record_resume_supersedes_head` (resumption.py:1489), which stamps `resume_superseded_head` with the resume instant, and `_latest_resume_at` in the settle reader's own module already combines that stamp with `auto_resume.at` (recovery_review_dispatch.py:206-224, used 30 lines below at :1302) — the gap is that `review_settle_seconds_remaining` reads only one of the two stamps it is handed a reader for; meanwhile writing `auto_resume` from the advice door feeds `previous_lift` (recovery_liveness.py:1124, recovery_classification.py:718), whose `trigger` is compared against a wait declaration's signature at recovery_liveness.py:1073 and, on a match, reports a wait-key defect that stops that run's lift loop

findings.reason: the queue orders only what the plan declares, so as declared §10 would launch ahead of §8 and its gate could not be produced at all; declaring `s10: [...#s7, ...#s8]` is what makes the measure reachable.
findings.text: §10's measure requires "a running settle-aware subscriber", and §8 states that process's trace is §10's measure (:266-267), yet `plan-section-depends-on` declares §10 upstream of §7 only (plan.html:23) with §8 an unattached sibling, so §10 is admitting-dispatchable before the subscriber it must trace exists

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `resumption.sweep` (reckon/crew/resumption.py:1768), `recovery_review_acceptance.dispatch_awaiting_reviews` (:377 of its module), `REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS` (recovery_review_dispatch.py:889), `review_settle_seconds_remaining` (:1258) and `runs.renew_producer_lease` (runs.py:2115) all resolve, and §8 does name exactly two lease files.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §10's done-when (:298) and its first negative control (:304) claim that a per-subscriber reflex fails the exactly-one test, but today's reflex is already idempotent per run.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §10 declares no artefact paths; its gate is a trace and a test set, and the station's own records stay on the node-local runtime root §5/§7 resolve.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or changelog prose reach §10's prose or the symbols it names.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §10 cures the advice-resume settle gap on the writer side by making the advice door write `auto_resume`, when the settle reader can read the resume instant the shared launch path already records, and `auto_resume` is read by three other rules as the sweep's lift cache.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §10 carries one deliverable, moving the review reflex and settle detection into the station; the advice-resume stamp is a clause of that same settle property.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §10's declared upstream is `the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once#s7` alone (plan.html:23), while its per-subscriber trace measure (:302) traces "a running settle-aware subscriber", a process only §8 delivers.
